Favicon Preview Tester

Upload a PNG, preview it at 16/32/48/180px, and download a real multi-size favicon.ico.

16px

32px

48px

180px

The .ico contains PNG-compressed 16, 32, and 48px entries — valid for all modern browsers.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a PNG (square works best).
  2. Check the 16/32/48/180px previews.
  3. Download favicon.ico (and the 180px PNG if you want).

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the .ico a real icon file?

A genuine ICO file: ICONDIR header plus PNG-compressed 16, 32, and 48px entries.

Which uploads are accepted?

Any raster image works, but square PNGs give the cleanest results.

What about Apple touch icons?

The 180px preview matches apple-touch-icon size; download it as PNG too.

Is my image uploaded anywhere?

Everything happens in your browser — the image never leaves your machine.
